blurb_title: The application no longer gets a fixed password. It gets a user that will not exist an hour from now.
blurb_1: This guide documents a complete, actually executed build: OpenBao creates short-lived PostgreSQL users on demand, the External Secrets Operator writes them into a Kubernetes Secret, and Miniflux reads them like any other environment variable – without ever knowing about OpenBao.
blurb_2: Every command, every manifest, every SQL statement. And every error that happened along the way: permission denied for schema public, is not an allowed role, the 403 that was just a missing login. Each one is a gate that exists on purpose.
code: -- The core of the guide in two lines CREATE ROLE "{{name}}" WITH LOGIN PASSWORD '{{password}}' VALID UNTIL '{{expiration}}' IN ROLE miniflux; ALTER ROLE "{{name}}" SET ROLE miniflux;
